title: InvoiceListRequest
description: The input of invoice.list: how many rows the caller would like, and where the page starts. This tutorial's own schema (step 13's README, decision 1). The limit is a wish: DSoR cuts it down to its own maximum (decision 2). NEW IN STEP 13, C4: a whole number of at least 1, and no maximum here, so a large limit is cut down, not refused (decision 5). NEW IN STEP 13, C3: the cursor is the last id of the page before, a place in the caller's own company only (decision 4). It looks like an id: the characters the specification's resourceUri pattern allows in an id, at most 64, so it cannot carry a URI, a NUL, or megabytes (decision 5, found by the review).
